Part of the [pycyxwiz API reference](index.md), pycyxwiz 0.2.0: each name with the signature and description the module itself reports. Types are shown without the `pycyxwiz.` prefix; `Sequence[int]` is any list or tuple of integers.

## Enumerations

- `Reduction`: `None`, `Mean`, `Sum`
- `TripletDistanceType`: `Euclidean`, `Cosine`

## Classes

### `BCEWithLogitsLoss`

Derives from `Loss`.

| Member | What it does |
|---|---|
| `BCEWithLogitsLoss(self: BCEWithLogitsLoss, reduction: Reduction = Reduction.Mean, pos_weight: float = 1.0, label_smoothing: float = 0.0) -> None` | Create BCEWithLogits Loss with optional positive-class weight and label smoothing |
| `backward(self: BCEWithLogitsLoss, predictions: Tensor, targets: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Backward: gradient w.r.t logits |
| `forward(self: BCEWithLogitsLoss, predictions: Tensor, targets: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Forward: compute binary cross entropy from logits |
| `label_smoothing` (property) | Label smoothing: targets become t x (1 - e) + e / 2 |
| `pos_weight` (property) | Positive-class weighting factor |

### `ContrastiveLoss`

Derives from `Loss`.

| Member | What it does |
|---|---|
| `ContrastiveLoss(self: ContrastiveLoss, margin: float = 1.0) -> None` | Create Contrastive Loss: L = (1-y)*d^2 + y*max(margin-d,0)^2 |
| `backward(self: ContrastiveLoss, x1: Tensor, x2: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Backward: gradient w.r.t x1 |
| `forward(self: ContrastiveLoss, x1: Tensor, x2: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Forward: compute contrastive loss (set labels via set_labels first) |
| `margin` (property) | Margin for dissimilar pairs (default: 1.0) |
| `set_labels(self: ContrastiveLoss, labels: Tensor) -> None` | Set labels: 0=similar (minimize distance), 1=dissimilar (push apart) |

### `CrossEntropyLoss`

Derives from `Loss`.

| Member | What it does |
|---|---|
| `CrossEntropyLoss(self: CrossEntropyLoss, reduction: Reduction = Reduction.Mean, ignore_index: int = -100, class_weights: Sequence[float] = [], label_smoothing: float = 0.0) -> None` | Create CrossEntropy Loss with optional per-class weights and label smoothing |
| `backward(self: CrossEntropyLoss, predictions: Tensor, targets: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Backward: gradient w.r.t logits |
| `class_weights` (property) | Per-class loss weights |
| `forward(self: CrossEntropyLoss, predictions: Tensor, targets: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Forward: compute cross entropy loss (predictions are logits) |
| `label_smoothing` (property) | Label smoothing factor |

### `FocalLoss`

Derives from `Loss`.

| Member | What it does |
|---|---|
| `FocalLoss(self: FocalLoss, alpha: float = 0.25, gamma: float = 2.0) -> None` | Create Focal Loss: FL(p_t) = -alpha * (1-p_t)^gamma * log(p_t) |
| `alpha` (property) | Class balance weight (default: 0.25) |
| `backward(self: FocalLoss, predictions: Tensor, targets: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Backward: gradient w.r.t logits |
| `forward(self: FocalLoss, predictions: Tensor, targets: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Forward: compute focal loss (predictions are logits) |
| `gamma` (property) | Focusing parameter - higher = more focus on hard examples (default: 2.0) |

### `JaccardLoss`

Derives from `Loss`.

| Member | What it does |
|---|---|
| `JaccardLoss(self: JaccardLoss, reduction: Reduction = Reduction.Mean, smooth: float = 1.0) -> None` | Create Jaccard/IoU loss for probability masks |
| `backward(self: JaccardLoss, predictions: Tensor, targets: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Backward: gradient w.r.t predictions |
| `forward(self: JaccardLoss, predictions: Tensor, targets: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Forward: compute Jaccard loss |
| `smooth` (property) | Smoothing constant |

### `Loss`

Base class of every loss. Subclass it in Python to write your own: define forward(self, predictions, targets) returning one value (a Tensor of one element) and backward(self, predictions, targets) returning dLoss/dpredictions with the predictions' shape, the mean scaling included. Call super().__init__() first.

| Member | What it does |
|---|---|
| `Loss(self: Loss) -> None` | Create a loss (for Python subclasses) |
| `backward(self: Loss, predictions: Tensor, targets: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Compute loss gradients |
| `forward(self: Loss, predictions: Tensor, targets: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Compute loss value |
| `get_name(self: Loss) -> str` | Get loss name |

### `MSELoss`

Derives from `Loss`.

| Member | What it does |
|---|---|
| `MSELoss(self: MSELoss) -> None` | Create MSE Loss: mean((predictions - targets)^2) |
| `backward(self: MSELoss, predictions: Tensor, targets: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Backward: dL/dy = 2*(predictions - targets)/N |
| `forward(self: MSELoss, predictions: Tensor, targets: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Forward: compute MSE loss |

| `SoftDiceLoss(self: SoftDiceLoss, reduction: Reduction = Reduction.Mean, smooth: float = 1.0) -> None` | Create Soft Dice loss for probability masks |

### `TripletLoss`

Derives from `Loss`.

| Member | What it does |
|---|---|
| `TripletLoss(self: TripletLoss, margin: float = 1.0, distance_type: TripletDistanceType = TripletDistanceType.Euclidean) -> None` | Create Triplet Loss: L = max(d(a,p) - d(a,n) + margin, 0) |
| `backward(self: TripletLoss, anchor: Tensor, positive: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Backward: gradient w.r.t anchor |
| `forward(self: TripletLoss, anchor: Tensor, positive: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Forward: compute triplet loss (set negative via set_negative first) |
| `margin` (property) | Margin for triplet loss (default: 1.0) |
| `set_negative(self: TripletLoss, negative: Tensor) -> None` | Set negative samples for triplet computation |
